why: Every hand patch the estate applies to an installed DSH engine tree, with the exact command that applies and checks it. Read by dsh-update/lib/patches.mjs. An install of a new engine version must end with every entry here reporting present (check exit 0), and with no unregistered .bak-harness-* pair left unexplained. See P3170 and dsh-update/DELIVERY.md.

patches.note: One malformed tool call must not kill a whole turn. Found 2026-10-05; the patcher embeds the repair engine and refuses if the upstream anchor moved.
A finished child agent must not die at settlement and lose its report. Found 2026-09-30.
Currency must render as text, not LaTeX. Found 2026-09-25. Targets the hashed vendor bundle, so it is resolved by glob, never by filename.
A second window must not reuse a blank workspace. Exit 4 means absent, 5 unverifiable (refuses on an unknown upstream).

UNREGISTERED AS OF 2026-10-19. The live tree carries .bak-harness-* siblings for this file from 2026-10-05 02:36-03:44, which means somebody patched it by hand four times and wrote no patcher. Until a patcher exists, the install-time audit decides it mechanically: if the new tree's file equals the old PATCHED file, upstream adopted the change and nothing is lost; otherwise the install FAILS and names this file. What would close it: a scripted diff of the backup against the patched file, the hunk expressed as a patcher, and this entry promoted to kind=script.
